title: Little War (Cuba)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Little War (Cuba)", at revision 1370626979, opens: "The Little War or Small War was the second of three conflicts between Cuban rebels and Spain. It started on 26 August 1879 and after some minor successes ended in rebel defeat in September 1880. It followed the Ten Years' War of 1868–78 and preceded the final war of 1895–98, which resulted in American intervention and Cuban independence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q400465, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "armed conflict in Cuba between 1878 and 1880". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
